title: Popover
description: A small panel that opens from a trigger and stays until dismissed, with a title and description, such as delivery details or a size guide.

components.Popover: Groups all parts of the popover.
components.PopoverAnchor: Sets the element the popover content is positioned against.
components.PopoverContent: Holds what the popover shows while open.
components.PopoverDescription: Explains the popover in a short text below its title.
components.PopoverHeader: Groups the title and description at the top of the popover.
components.PopoverTitle: Names what the popover is about.
